subject: Scheduling: Redwood Inference demo — US / EU / APAC executive attendees

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>

Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 6 Mar 2026 09:07:00 -0800
Subject: Kickoff demo: coordinating times across US / EU / APAC

Hi Kaito / Emma / Michael —

Thanks again for the interest in Redwood Inference. We want to do a 45–60 minute exec-level demo + Q&A that includes your engineering lead and two of our execs (CTO + Head of Sales). We have stakeholders in the US, EU and APAC, so I wanted to propose a couple windows and check constraints before we send a calendar invite.

Attached: Demo-agenda.pdf and Exec-availability-sheet.xlsx (fillable).

Candidate windows (I listed local times for clarity):
- Option A: 2026-03-09 08:30 PT / 2026-03-09 16:30 CET / 2026-03-10 00:30 JST
- Option B: 2026-03-09 07:00 PT / 2026-03-09 15:00 CET / 2026-03-09 23:00 JST
- Option C: 2026-03-10 09:00 PT / 2026-03-10 17:00 CET / 2026-03-11 01:00 JST

Quick note: the US switches to Daylight Saving Time on Sunday 8 Mar 2026 — that shifts our Pacific times forward by +1 hour relative to CET through late March. I called out local times above but please confirm your actual timezone/offset so we avoid mixups.

Can you reply with preferred option or paste a few times that work on your side? If you prefer, fill the attached sheet and I’ll lock in a time.

Thanks — looking forward to it.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Senior Solutions Manager
Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai
+1 415-555-0132

Attachments: Demo-agenda.pdf, Exec-availability-sheet.xlsx

From: Kaito Saito <kaito.saito@zencloud.jp>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 6 Mar 2026 17:12:00 +0900
Subject: Re: Kickoff demo: coordinating times across US / EU / APAC

Hi Marissa —

Thanks for the options. Our team in Tokyo prefers something after 15:00 JST because of local exec schedules. Option B at 23:00 JST is ok for one of our VPs but a bit late for our engineering lead. Option A (00:30 JST) is too late. Option C on 10th Mar at 01:00 JST is also late but possible.

Practical constraints: our CTO is only available on 10 Mar between 15:00–17:00 JST (which maps to 07:00–09:00 CET on 10 Mar and 23:00–01:00 PT on 9–10 Mar depending on DST). Also — note that Japan doesn't observe DST so offsets are fixed.

If there's flexibility, could we aim for 2026-03-10 08:30 CET (which would be 23:30 JST on 10 Mar and 00:30 PT on 10 Mar if I did the math)? I'm happy to defer to your exec availability — just want to flag the JST constraints.

Regards,
Kaito
Head of Product, ZenCloud
kaito.saito@zencloud.jp

UK team is flexible in the afternoon CET window. Option B / Option C both look fine for us. Small ask: could we keep it no earlier than 15:00 CET — our CFO needs to step out at 14:30.

From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>

Date: Sat, 7 Mar 2026 11:20:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Kickoff demo: coordinating times across US / EU / APAC

Marissa —

Quick scheduling note from my side (ops): the US switches to DST on Sun 8 Mar at 02:00 local time, so our Pacific offsets in the calendar will flip from -08:00 to -07:00. That means the wall-clock times you proposed for 9 Mar in PT need to be double-checked against CET/JST.

Given exec availability, I recommend we avoid very late-night JST slots. If ZenCloud's CTO can do 10 Mar 15:00 JST as Kaito mentioned, the cleanest mapping for our CTO + Head of Sales would be:
- 2026-03-10 07:00 PT (after DST) / 2026-03-10 15:00 CET / 2026-03-10 23:00 JST

That is tight for APAC but within reason. Alternatively, we can flip to a slightly earlier EU time (14:30 CET) to land around 22:30 JST and 06:30 PT, but that may be too early for our US execs.

I'm happy to coordinate the calendar once we have confirmation from ZenCloud.

Cheers,
Jonas
Director, Product Ops
jonas_weber@redwood.ai

2026-03-10 at 07:30 PT (PDT, UTC-7) / 15:30 CET (UTC+1) / 23:30 JST (UTC+9) — 45 minutes + 15 minute buffer for Q&A.

If that works for ZenCloud and FinServe, I will send a calendar invite and include the demo agenda + a link to a recording stub if folks need to dial in asynchronously.

Marissa
